I'm assuming a **photorealistic** style and a tool-agnostic prompt, with notes for Midjourney, Flux/SDXL and GPT-image/Gemini. I've fixed the details that usually drift between shots (face, hair, glasses, wardrobe, accessories) so the same wording can go into every later prompt.

**How to use it for consistency:**
1. Generate the reference sheet (Prompt A) a few times and pick the best one.
2. Crop a clean front headshot from it and save it as `narine_ref.png`.
3. For every later shot, put the **Identity Block** at the start of your prompt, attach `narine_ref.png` as a character or image reference, and add only the scene details.
4. Don't change the Identity Block between shots. If you change anything (a different cardigan, hair down), do it on purpose and write it down.

## FINAL

### Identity Block (paste verbatim into every prompt)
```
Narine, a 41-year-old Armenian woman, translator in a corporate office, 2026. Oval face with defined cheekbones, strong straight nose with a slight bump at the bridge, full but neat dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown almond eyes with faint shadows underneath, fine crow's-feet lines, light olive skin with natural texture and no heavy retouching. Dark espresso-brown shoulder-length hair with a few visible grey strands at the temples, pulled back in a low loose clip with a few strands falling free. Thin rectangular tortoiseshell reading glasses (often pushed up on her head or hanging on a thin black cord). Minimal makeup: soft mauve lip, light mascara. Small gold stud earrings, thin gold wristwatch on left wrist, no rings. Expression: tired but sharp, observant, a slightly skeptical half-smile; intelligent, attentive gaze. Average height, medium build, upright but slightly weary posture.
Wardrobe (default): charcoal-grey fine-knit cardigan over a cream silk-blend blouse, high-waisted navy straight-leg trousers, black low-block-heel leather loafers, a worn brown leather tote bag.
```

### Prompt A: Character Reference Sheet (master)
```
Character reference sheet of [IDENTITY BLOCK]. Clean professional character turnaround on a plain light-grey studio background, even soft diffused lighting, no shadows on backdrop. Layout: top row — full-body standing turnaround in four views: front, three-quarter, side profile, back, neutral relaxed pose, arms at sides, same outfit in every view. Bottom row — five head-and-shoulders close-ups showing expressions: neutral focused, tired exhale with glasses pushed up, sharp skeptical raised eyebrow, small genuine warm smile, concentrated reading with glasses on. Small detail insets: tortoiseshell glasses, gold watch, hair clip, loafers. Identical face, hair, and clothing across all views, consistent proportions, photorealistic, 85mm lens look, natural skin texture, true-to-life color, high detail, model-sheet clarity, no text, no labels, no watermark.
```

### Prompt B: Front headshot anchor (for the reference image)
```
Front-facing passport-style head-and-shoulders portrait of [IDENTITY BLOCK]. Looking directly at camera, neutral-tired but alert expression, glasses on, plain light-grey background, soft even key light from front-left, shallow depth of field, 85mm f/2.8, photorealistic, natural skin texture, no retouching, no text.
```

### Prompt C: Per-shot template
```
[IDENTITY BLOCK]
Scene: [action — e.g. translating a contract at her desk, two monitors, a bilingual dictionary and a cold cup of coffee beside her].
Setting: [modern open-plan office in Yerevan, late afternoon, overcast window light].
Camera: [medium shot / close-up / wide], [35mm / 50mm / 85mm], eye level.
Mood: [quiet fatigue, focused].
Photorealistic, cinematic natural color grade, consistent character appearance.
```

### Negative prompt (SD/Flux/any tool that supports it)
```
cartoon, anime, illustration, 3d render, plastic skin, heavy makeup, glamour, youthful, teenage, elderly, different hairstyle, blonde, extra fingers, deformed hands, mismatched outfit, inconsistent face, text, labels, watermark, logo
```

### Settings
| Tool | Settings |
|---|---|
| **Midjourney (v7)** | Sheet: `--ar 16:9 --style raw --stylize 50`. Headshot: `--ar 4:5 --style raw`. Later shots: add `--oref <narine_ref URL> --ow 100–200` (use `--cref <URL> --cw 100` on v6). Keep `--seed` fixed while you test variations. |
| **Flux / SDXL** | Sheet: 1536×864 (16:9). Shots: 1024×1280 or 1344×768. CFG 3.5 (Flux) / 5–6 (SDXL), 30–40 steps, fixed seed. Use IP-Adapter FaceID or PuLID at 0.7–0.85 strength with `narine_ref.png`. For longer projects, train a LoRA on 15–20 approved shots. |
| **GPT-image / Gemini** | Paste the full prompt and attach `narine_ref.png` with this instruction: "Keep this exact person's face, hair, glasses and outfit." Choose landscape for the sheet and portrait for headshots. |
